added_failures_note: measured from the reviewed run's own gate logs through the store's own reader: logs/gate-base.log (revision bcaf26dcf9f61ea6dd0832f04c28495fd0475a0c) names the two new cases as FAILED behind its "2 failed, 102 passed" summary and logs/gate-head.log (revision 3f05a8815511d853062a1627954025b34f207304) names none behind "104 passed", so the head log's failure set minus the base log's is empty and the zero is a measurement, not an unread log; the reviewed manifest names its arms under test_logs and artifacts rather than the store's baseline_suite/after_suite fields, so reckon/crew/review.py:733 finds no gate log for this run and a reader that annotates through the store will report the count unmeasured, while the figures stored here are the derivation from those two logs.

findings.text: "raise exc from rollback_failure" sets __cause__ on the original exception, so when the original already carried its own cause — the launch wrapper at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:5334 raises its D22 refusal with "from exc" — the double-failure path (launch refuses and the unwind then fails) prints the rollback failure as the original's direct cause and drops the inner OSError from the chain, which a reader diagnosing an absent harness executable sees only as text embedded in the refusal message.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base bcaf26dcf — 86deb9c1 adds the 273-line test module, 3f05a881 carries the whole fix (the dispatch unwind wrapped in one try with "raise exc from rollback_failure" and a stderr line carrying the run id, and the roster guard's row comparison moved onto _registration_content), and 153767e48 adds only the 145-line evidence fragment, which is why the gate's head revision 3f05a8815 still covers every source line under review.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when asks for both defects reproduced at base in the new test file, a fix that keeps the original surfaced with the rollback failure still visible on it, a capture-only change admitted while a real member change still refuses, a declared mutation reddening the first case, and gate arms run at base and at head; logs/gate-base.log (base bcaf26dcf) names exactly the two new cases as FAILED with no other file failing, logs/gate-head.log (head 3f05a8815) reads "104 passed", and logs/negative-control.log restores the base rollback and reddens only the first case.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal has two halves — a dispatch that raises after publishing its pointer and cutting its worktree must report the error that stopped it rather than one its own unwind raised, and a roster whose only uncommitted change is a session capture must admit a registration; reckon/crew/dispatch.py:5363-5395 wraps the unwind in one guard and re-raises the original with the rollback failure attached and printed, and reckon/ledger.py:1170-1262 compares member rows through _registration_content, which drops session_id, session_model and sessions; both halves are exercised by the two cases the base arm fails.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records both base reproductions, the base 2 failed/102 passed and head 104 passed arms as JSON carrying completed true, the mutation's red log, and the scratch it deleted; one recorded fact does not hold — the deletion list names uv-9ed71d7374503d81.lock, which is still present in /tmp/reckon-crew-scratch/r-rollback-keeps-its-cause with an mtime of 18:53 local against a manifest written at 19:38 local, so that entry survived the cleanup the artifact line reports as done.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared scope is reckon/crew/dispatch.py, reckon/ledger.py, tests/test_a_rollback_keeps_its_cause.py, docs/evidence/fragments/a-review-dies-where-nobody-is-looking/a-rollback-keeps-its-cause.html and the figures directory beside it; git diff bcaf26dcf..153767e48 changes exactly those four files (the figures directory is unused) and git status in the worked tree is clean.

justifications.durability: the dispatch half is reddened by the declared mutation in logs/negative-control.log ("1 failed, 4 passed"), and the roster half by the base arm itself, where tests/test_a_rollback_keeps_its_cause.py::test_a_capture_only_ledger_admits_a_registration fails with "cannot commit roster registration 'worker-b': uncommitted member registration(s): worker-a"; the added assertions read back git-committed roster content at tests/test_a_rollback_keeps_its_cause.py:240-242 and 260 rather than the values the test handed the ledger.
justifications.evidence: logs/gate-base.log and logs/gate-head.log record both arms with their revisions and literal commands and the manifest repeats them as JSON with completed true, but the reviewed manifest names them under test_logs/artifacts rather than the store's baseline_suite and after_suite fields, so reckon/crew/review.py:733 finds no gate log for this run and the added-failure count is unmeasured to every reader that annotates through the store, and one cleanup claim in the artifact line does not hold.
justifications.fit: the new symbols are named for what they do (_registration_content, _SESSION_CAPTURE_FIELDS) and the comments state the mechanism without a plan or ticket reference, the one idiom note being that the stderr line at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:5393 introduces a "crew: " prefix that appears nowhere else in the repository while the module's other messages print bare.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/dispatch.py:5387 re-raises the original as the surfaced exception and reckon/ledger.py:1259 admits a capture-only row, both matching the goal, the single qualification being that "raise exc from rollback_failure" replaces a launch failure's own __cause__ set at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:5334, so on the double-failure path the inner OSError disappears from the printed chain though its text survives inside the D22 refusal message.
justifications.scope_discipline: every file in git diff bcaf26dcf..153767e48 is inside the five declared paths, the worked tree is clean, and the ruff claim reproduces — "ruff check" reports the same 15 findings at base and at head over the three changed files and "ruff format --diff" is 100 lines at each, so the commit adds none.
